records.name: Sundhnúkur fissure episodes — satellite observations
records.coverage: Sundhnúkur crater row and Grindavík, Reykjanes peninsula, Iceland
records.measurement: Landsat 9 TIRS-2 thermal map over a digital elevation model
records.license: NASA imagery reuse permitted, including commercial use; credited USGS Landsat data

processing: Retain published image framing and illustrative labels
Encode WebP without changing the lava-field shapes
records.limitation: Thermal radiation is not lava thickness. The December and January episode controls inspect the same January observation. Plate-boundary drawing is schematic, without a distance scale.

processing: Retain published framing

Write a short factual summary; no fissure geometry inferred

records.name: Mount St. Helens, 1973 / 1983
records.observationDate: 1973 and 1983 (years provided by this published pair)
records.coverage: Mount St. Helens and surrounding blast-affected landscape, Washington, USA
records.license: Public domain (explicitly stated on source page)
records.attribution: USGS Landsat Missions / EROS, Mount St. Helens 1973–1983.
processing: Use the paired, equal-dimension publisher images
Encode WebP with the same framing; no warping or terrain morphing
records.limitation: The after image is from 1983, three years after the collapse. Spectral and seasonal differences are not solely eruption effects. No elevation difference is computed from imagery.

records.name: From the 1980 eruption to 2000 — Fact Sheet 036-00

processing: Summarize chronology and reported elevations
Draw a qualitative northern-flank silhouette; no DEM reconstruction
records.limitation: The silhouette is an explanatory reconstruction. Reported summit heights are facts; the drawn outline is not surveyed geometry.

records.name: DANTE — Database of Etna’s historical eruptions

records.measurement: Historical eruption catalogue and published deposit map

processing: Retain the published map and legend
Extract selected catalogue rows from XLSX
Isolate color classes within the map area; no digitized vector boundaries or inferred deposit thickness

processing: Retain the published paired images and labels
Encode WebP without reframing
Use matching proportional crops for the investigation lens

records.name: 79 CE eruption — stratigraphy and eruptive dynamics
records.observationDate: 79 CE deposits; modern stratigraphic interpretation (survey dates not specified)
records.coverage: Somma–Vesuvius and archaeological sites including Pompeii
records.measurement: Published interpretation of eruptive units EU1–EU8
records.license: Reference only; no INGV artwork or text reproduced
records.attribution: Scientific basis: INGV Osservatorio Vesuviano, “L’eruzione di Pompei (79 d.C.)”, edited by F. Sansivero. Diagram and explanatory prose by NOT YET LAND.
processing: Summarize selected deposit types in original prose
Draw a generalized illustrated sequence with arbitrary layer thickness
Separate deposit evidence, eyewitness account and modern inference
records.limitation: A selected, generalized sequence, not a measured excavation log. Thicknesses are not to scale; not every unit occurs at every site. The calendar date of the eruption remains debated.

records.name: Kīlauea summit — archived 3DEP elevation
records.observationDate: Tile-wide sources: 1954–2023; exact summit epoch unresolved

processing: Native GeoTIFF crop
Bilinear resampling to 129² / 257²
16-bit heightfield encoding; display exaggeration 1.5×
records.limitation: Mixed-epoch archive, not a 2018 before/after surface. Publisher datum NAVD88; applicability to this Hawaiian crop has not been independently validated.

records.coverage: Sundhnúkur crater row, Svartsengi volcanic system, Iceland
records.measurement: Published fissure outlines mapped from aerial and satellite imagery; visible and inferred faults distinguished in legend

Extract embedded Figure 7 from PDF page 9 with Poppler
Retain all panels, original scale and legend; encode WebP
